native_blank_conditions.source_sample: positive-measurement gr blank-catalogue positions inside the registered splice circle, not uniform random pixels

scope: Rerun on real calibrated CCDs; released mask and preserved outer background. Unique 0.8 arcsec matching, counting existing sources present in the blank as blends. Image experiments assess conditional response in selected stamps. Registered correct_mode_exists and C fit refer to the highest-ranking spatially matched A group. The separate any-spatial-group distance diagnostic does not replace those frozen metrics.
